stationarity.method: stationarity of the per-acquisition dwell phase-coherence series: Theil-Sen slope with moving-block bootstrap CI, Mann-Kendall, first/second-half split with Cliff's delta, annual harmonic, lag-1 autocorrelation, runs test and Ljung-Box on the detrended series; every series stratified by band x time base x orbit

event_note: the record is event-free: no damage_label, no structural_state, no condition_label on any of the 150 rows and no event in the window; the two groups are the orbit geometries

class_text.ASCENDING: compact coherent echo, above the LUMO reference scale and the 0.15 pipeline floor — usable
class_text.DESCENDING: below the LUMO reference scale for this geometry
